name: podcastindex
description: Podcast Index MCP server and CLI for Claude Code, Codex and AI agents. 36 tools for podcast search, episode transcripts you can actually read and search, Podcasting 2.0 tags, value-for-value data, feed health and index stats.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Podcast Index, the open podcast directory.

One free API key and secret, from api.podcastindex.org/signup, cover every reading tool. Both halves are needed: the key identifies you and the secret signs each request.

It searches four million podcasts and then opens the transcript: Podcast Index hands out a link to an episode's transcript file, and this fetches it and gives your AI the words with timestamps and speakers.

Adding a feed to the public index cannot be undone through the API, so submit_feed and submit_feed_by_itunes_id refuse to run without an explicit confirmation, and they also need a key with write permission. Turn Read only on to remove every write from the tool list.

api_key.title: Podcast Index API key
api_key.description: Free from api.podcastindex.org/signup. It arrives by email with its secret.

api_secret.title: Podcast Index API secret
api_secret.description: The secret that came with the key. Both are needed: the secret signs every request.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide the three tools that write: the recrawl ping and the two that add a feed to the index.

allow_destructive.title: Allow adding feeds to the index
allow_destructive.description: Turn this off to keep the recrawl ping while blocking submit_feed and submit_feed_by_itunes_id, which cannot be undone.
